full_judgment:
Md Rezaul Haque, J: On an application under section 561A of the Code or Criminal Procedure Rule was issued calling upon the opposite party to show cause as to why the judgment and order dated 16-10-2019 passed by the learned Sessions Judge, Sunamganj in Criminal Revision No. 68 of 2018, arising out of Jagannatpur Police Station Case No. 10 dated 17-9-2017, corresponding to GR Case No. 148 of 2017, under sections 143, 323, 324, 326, 307, 302 and 34 of the Penal Code, now pending in the Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Sunamganj setting aside the order dated 24-5-2018 passed by the learned Judicial Magistrate, Sunamganj for trying Jagannathpur police station Case No. 10 dated 17-9-2017, corresponding to GR Case No. 148 of 2017 and CR Case No. 66 of 2018 (Jagannathpur) together should not be quashed and/or pass such other or further order or orders as to this Court may seem fit and proper. 

 3. The facts for disposal of this Rule in short are that the prosecution story of the GR Case No. 148 of 2017, in brief, is that on 17-9-2017, one Abul Khayer, son of late Abdul Mannan, of village: Shridarpasha, Police Station: Jagannatpur, District: Sunamganj lodged a First Information Report (hereinafter referred to as 'FIR') against 38 (thirty eight) named and 20/30 unnamed accused alleging, inter alia, that on 16-9-2017 at about 01-00 hour, the accused persons being assembled with deadly weapons attacked the deceased witnesses at the place of occurrence and caused grievous hurt and, as such, Jagannatpur Police Station Case No. 10 dated 17-9-2017 was registered under sections 143, 323, 324, 325, 326, 307 and 114 of the Penal Code, 1860. Thereafter on 27-9-2017, one of the victim died in hospital that after the completion of investigation, on 22-3-2018, Investigating Officer submitted charge-sheet being No. 39 against 40(forty) persons excluding 2(two) FIR named persons under sections 143, 323, 324, 325, 326, 307, 302, 34 of the Penal Code, 1860.
